headline: Inflation at 2.9% in July, Reggio Calabria at 4%: Where Prices Are Rising Fastest
summary: Italian consumer prices rose 2.9% year on year in July, slower than the prior pace but revised upward from the initial estimate, Istat said. Prices rose 0.3% month on month.
why: Istat is Italy's national statistics agency, and its inflation data guides European Central Bank policy expectations for the eurozone's third-largest economy.
